title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on Exodus 35: the Sabbath command, the willing offerings for the tabernacle and the calling of Bezalel and Oholiab.

questions.text: According to Moses, what would happen to whoever did any work on the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: Moses said the seventh day was a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh, and whoever did any work in it would be put to death.

answers.text: He would be put to death
He would be sent out of the camp
He would pay a fine of silver
He would bring a sin offering

questions.text: What were the Israelites not allowed to do throughout their homes on the Sabbath day?
questions.explanation: Moses said: "You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day."

questions.text: Who was invited to bring an offering to Yahweh for the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Yahweh commanded that whoever was of a willing heart should bring it as Yahweh's offering.

answers.text: Only the rulers of the tribes
Whoever was of a willing heart

questions.text: Who was told to come and make all that Yahweh had commanded?
questions.explanation: Moses said: "Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded."

answers.text: The young men of each tribe

questions.text: Which gold jewels did the men and women bring as an offering?
questions.explanation: Those who were willing-hearted brought brooches, earrings, signet rings and armlets, all jewels of gold.

answers.text: Brooches, earrings, signet rings and armlets

questions.text: What did the women whose hearts stirred them up in wisdom spin?
questions.explanation: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats' hair.

questions.text: Who brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and the breastplate?
questions.explanation: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

questions.text: From which tribe was Bezalel, the son of Uri?
questions.explanation: Moses said Yahweh had called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

questions.text: With what did Yahweh fill Bezalel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge and in all kinds of workmanship.

answers.text: The gift of prophecy for the nations

questions.text: Who was named together with Bezalel as one who could teach, and from which tribe was he?
questions.explanation: Yahweh put it in Bezalel's heart to teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

answers.text: Joshua, of the tribe of Ephraim
Oholiab, of the tribe of Dan
Hur, of the tribe of Judah
Eleazar, of the tribe of Levi
